question: What is the name of the bridge in Bihar that has become Asia's widest extradosed bridge?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aunta-Simaria Ganga Bridge.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Aunta-Simaria Ganga Bridge in Bihar is Asia's widest extradosed bridge.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The bridge has a 34-meter-wide deck and spans over the River Ganga, strategically located between Aunta and Simaria.**
 
• The project integrates North and South Bihar, reducing travel time by over an hour and significantly improving regional connectivity.
 
• It is a six-lane bridge that will provide a direct connection between Patna and Begusarai, reducing travel time significantly.
 
• The Aunta-Simaria Ganga Bridge is designed to handle heavy traffic, making it a key infrastructure project in the region.
 
• The bridge also aims to improve connectivity to key areas like Simaria Dham, a pilgrimage site in the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Extradosed Bridge__

 __
 
• A type of bridge combining aspects of both cable-stayed and cantilevered bridges
 
• Characterized by a hybrid structure that provides both efficiency and aesthetic appeal
 
 
 
• Ganga River__
 __
 
• One of the major rivers in India, running through multiple states including Bihar
 
• The bridge spans the Ganga River, improving connectivity between North and South Bihar
 
 
 
• Simaria Dham__
 
 
• A renowned pilgrimage site located in the region, benefiting from improved accessibility via the bridge
